title: Carlos Yulo misses World Championship podium floor in Rotterdam
summary: Double Olympic champion Carlos Yulo scored 13.233 to place eighth in the men's floor exercise final at the FIG Artistic Gymnastics World Championships in Rotterdam, Netherlands.
